recommended_growth_continuity_claim: Within the processed normalized corpus, safety-side growth evidence is more numerous, but unit-cycle-weighted rates do not show a uniform safety advantage. Step progression currently leans safety/police (7.44% versus 2.75% for non-safety), while across-the-board raises are mixed (fire 6.32%, non-safety 6.06%, police 4.02%) and COLA/CPI cross-side comparisons remain too small to resolve. The strongest current interpretation is mechanism- and cycle-specific divergence, not a general safety wage-growth premium.
